properties.interpretation: This prominent feature at low R+ΔR and moderate k is characteristic of the first coordination shell, typically representing strong scattering from nearest-neighbor atoms (e.g., metal-ligand bonds like M-O or M-S). Its high intensity suggests a well-defined and significant scattering path.

This broader and weaker feature at higher R+ΔR suggests scattering from more distant coordination shells or multiple scattering paths. It could correspond to second or higher coordination shells (e.g., metal-metal distances or longer metal-ligand distances). Its broader nature might indicate more disorder or a superposition of several less intense scattering paths.
